items.name: Road
items.label: Cobblestone road (2 × 2 m)
items.place: the street's middle tiles; the cobbles continue across every joint

items.name: RoadCurb
items.label: Road + curb (2 × 2 m)
items.place: the street's edge tile: the curb is on its +Z side, a Sidewalk tile goes beyond it

items.name: RoadCorner
items.label: Road corner + curb (2 × 2 m)
items.place: an outer street corner: curbs on +Z and +X

items.name: RoadCrossing
items.label: Road crossing (2 × 2 m)
items.place: in a street of Road tiles: a pale-slab pedestrian crossing across it

items.name: Sidewalk
items.label: Sidewalk flagstones (2 × 2 m)
items.place: beyond a RoadCurb, 0.35 m top = the curb top; also a plaza / market floor

items.name: StoneStairs
items.label: Stone stairs (2 × 2 m, 1 m rise)
items.place: on the 2 m grid; climbs 1 m towards −Z (rotate to turn it)

items.name: Well
items.label: Village well
items.place: the centrepiece of a small square

items.name: Fountain
items.label: Town fountain
items.place: in the middle of a 4 × 4 m plaza of Sidewalk tiles

items.name: MarketStall
items.label: Market stall (striped awning)
items.place: on Sidewalk tiles, open side to the street

items.name: LampPost
items.label: Street lamp post
items.place: on the sidewalk 0.5 m from the curb, every 6-8 m

items.name: ParkBench
items.label: Park bench
items.place: on the sidewalk or round the fountain

items.name: MarketCart
items.label: Market cart
items.place: by a stall or at the roadside

items.name: HayBale
items.label: Hay bale
items.place: stack them (0.45 m high each)

items.name: FlowerBox
items.label: Flower box
items.place: on a window sill (architecture-kit WallStoneWindow sill at y 1.0) or along a fence

items.name: NoticeBoard
items.label: Notice board (blank)
items.place: by the well or a crossroads; the board is blank for your own decal

items.name: ClockTowerTop
items.label: Clock tower top
items.place: on top of a 4 × 4 m tower of architecture-kit walls (centred, at the wall tops: y = 3 per storey)

items.name: Fence
items.label: Picket fence (2 m)
items.place: runs on the 2 m grid: sections share their end posts (two half posts make one)

items.name: FenceGate
items.label: Garden gate + frame (2 m, opens)
items.place: in a fence run like a section; click it in Interact/Play to open/close

items.name: Bridge
items.label: Wooden footbridge (4.4 m)
items.place: over a nature-kit stream or pond edge; runs along Z, ends at 0.24 m

items.name: Banner
items.label: Wall banner
items.place: on a wall: origin on the wall face (back plane z = 0), facing +Z

items.name: BannerPole
items.label: Banner pole
items.place: at a square's corners or a bridge end

items.name: Signpost
items.label: Signpost (blank)
items.place: at a crossroads; the boards are blank

items.name: HayStack
items.label: Hay bale stack
items.place: by a cart or a barn door

items.name: LoadedCart
items.label: Market cart (loaded)
items.place: at the roadside (on the road: y 0.20)

items.name: BarrelCluster
items.label: Barrels (cluster)
items.place: by a stall, a tavern door or the dock (props-kit barrels, re-used)

items.name: SacksBarrel
items.label: Grain sacks + barrel
items.place: by a stall or on the cart's tailboard side (props-kit sacks + barrel, re-used)

items.name: FlowerBoxLong
items.label: Flower box (2 m)
items.place: along a 2 m fence section or under a wide window
